item.title: 3 left with serious injuries after Greensboro crash on Summit Avenue, EMS says
item.description: GREENSBORO, N.C. (WGHP) -- Three people were left with serious injuries after a crash in Greensboro on Saturday, according to EMS. The crash happened on Summit Avenue between Cody Avenue and Cherry Lane. The cause of the crash is unknown at this time.
